Compare a session renamed via Claude's own /rename with one renamed via agents (find real examples on disk if possible; grep `custom-title` in ~/.claude/projects/*/*.jsonl with head).
3. Root cause: which store Claude reads that agents does not update (or updates in a form Claude ignores, or Claude only reads it at startup/caches it in a running process). Also check whether a live running Claude process would pick up a change without a restart.

Write the full report to /Users/satoshi/.claude/jobs/b40586a7/tmp/rename/report.md (mkdir -p). Root cause first with file:line, then evidence, then fix direction. Reply with the path and a ≤10-line summary.
